label: English
source_guidance: Interpret English tense, relative clauses and implicit references. Brother/sister alone does not establish relative age, and a form of address does not establish kinship.
target_guidance: Use natural English fiction prose, handling tense, articles, pronouns and dialogue rhythm. Do not copy source-language word order.
punctuation_rule: Use English punctuation and spacing. Preserve the structure and pairing of quotation marks, brackets, dashes, ellipses and special symbols; do not apply another writing system’s full-width punctuation rules.
title_rule: Use conventional English chapter titles and translate section labels by meaning, for example Chapter 3, Prologue and Epilogue.
term_guidance: Leave reading empty unless there is explicit pronunciation evidence.
